questions.explanation: Haberler propounded the opportunity cost theory of international trade. Haberler determined the exchange ratio between two goods under different cost conditions with two goods under different cost conditions with the help of production possibility curve, which are as follows - (i) Under fixed cost production, the production possibility curve is a straight line falling from left to right. In this situation, both the countries will benefit from international trade and there will be complete specialization in production. (ii) In the case of decreasing opportunity cost, the production possibility curve is concave to the origin. Under this condition, the countries engaged in trade adopt complete specialization. (iii) In case of increasing opportunity cost, the production possibility curve is concave towards the origin. Under the condition, the countries engaged in trade adopt partial specialization.
